svg.title: Bioprocess Troubleshooting Assistant — implemented architecture and roadmap
svg.desc: Spatial architecture inspired by a source-to-ingestion-to-storage map. Sources and ingestion are above the serving workflow. The client sends a question to the agent, Neo4j retrieval returns facts, the agent selects result IDs, and deterministic rendering returns the answer to the client. Future promotion and telemetry are dashed coral. No vector retrieval, Redis or Telegram is currently implemented.
svg.text: Sources → ingestion → storage · Then a bounded agent loop, with explicit future connections
Manual test: no Docling Graph or automatic chunking
Does not enrich the chatbot automatically
ROADMAP · use reviewed facts in chat
Possible causes and actions · linked to manual sources
How good are retrieval and answers?
Scores depend on configured metrics / judges
How does the assistant handle attacks?
Automated scores and checks do not replace human source review.
Test cases in; outputs and checks out
Shared connection to the application workflow
Logical grouping · all integrations remain roadmap
Graph search vs text passages vs LightRAG
GUARDS · Unknown conditions stay unknown; local records and reviewed manual statements need separate adapters.
Documentary evidence ≠ scientific validation. Local documents; serving currently uses the Anthropic API.
